profileHeader.headline: Entry-level Content & Marketing Professional seeking roles in Sydney.

dhpView.personalStory: Jordan Lee is a 24-year-old Bachelor of Communications graduate from UTS, eager to launch a career in content or marketing. Currently gaining valuable customer communication skills in hospitality, Jordan is actively seeking an entry-level role to apply proven writing, audience awareness, and project thinking. Jordan is motivated to demonstrate these capabilities and contribute to a dynamic team.
